title: Mountain dew
html_source:
A term for whiskey originating in the early 1800s (first use c. 1816). The name derives specifically from Highland Scotch whiskey.

Queen Victoria was known for heavy drinking and helped popularize Scotch whiskey. As stated here, she reputedly carried a flask of the tipple around with her at all times. See, e.g., this link.
